activity.notes: Nalanda copperplate names Balaputradeva king of Suvarnadvipa in Devapala's 39th regnal year. Its absolute CE date is disputed (including ca.845–850 versus the conventional ca.860); this approximate 860 event is a representative person-specific inscription point, NOT a reign lasting only one year or an exact date. Do not assume that Srivijaya and Suvarnadvipa are distinct or identical live Polities without exact identity review.

sources.title: R. C. Majumdar (1933), Les rois Śailendra de Suvarnadvīpa, BEFEO 33:121–141
sources.citation_text: Majumdar discusses the Nalanda copperplate dated to Devapala's 39th regnal year explicitly naming Balaputradeva ruler of Suvarnadvipa; the AD date is debated.
